title: Settings
loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.

account.heading: Account
account.timezoneHint: An IANA name, for example Europe/Warsaw. It decides “today” and the clocks in the owner's zone.
account.timezoneInvalid: This is not a known time zone.

style.heading: Style
style.themeNote: There is one theme (dark); you choose the accent colour of the dashboard.
style.previewBody: This is how the accent looks on a widget card.
style.noScreen: You have no dashboard yet. Make it in the Designer to choose its accent.

dateFormat.heading: Date format
dateFormat.note: It changes only how dates are shown; what is stored stays as it is.

options.heading: Advanced options
options.hint: Changing a limit never removes or trims data that is already stored.
options.restart: Takes effect after the application restarts.
options.env: Set in the installation file; it cannot be changed here.
options.readOnly: Changed only in the installation file.
options.stepUp: This change needs a TOTP code (available with the security of the account).

errors.OUT_OF_RANGE: The value is outside the allowed range.
errors.NOT_LISTED: Choose one of the values on the list.
errors.SETTING_INVALID: The server did not accept this value.
errors.SETTING_CONFLICT: This value conflicts with another setting.
errors.SETTING_LOCKED_BY_ENV: This option is set in the installation file.
errors.SETTING_READ_ONLY: This option cannot be changed here.
errors.STEP_UP_REQUIRED: This change needs a TOTP code.

leave.heading: Unsaved changes
leave.text: You have unsaved changes in the options. Leaving discards them.

options.backupDiskReserve: Disk space kept free for copies
options.logsRetention: How long rotated logs are kept
options.updatesCheck: Check for updates once a day
options.backupNightlyKeep: How many nightly copies to keep
options.backupSafetyKeepDays: How long safety copies are kept
options.auditRetention: How long the audit log is kept
options.tablesDefaultPageSize: Default rows on a page of a table

security.heading: Security
security.loadFailed: This section could not be loaded.

sessions.heading: Sessions
sessions.hint: The browsers you are signed in on. Ending another session takes effect at once.

devices.heading: Trusted devices
devices.hint: On a trusted device sign-in does not ask for a TOTP code. After a device is revoked the code is asked for again.
devices.name: Device

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.hint: Events newest first, fifty to a page. It holds kinds of actions and permitted context, never passwords, codes or tokens.

stepUp.codeText: This action needs a fresh code from your authenticator app. A code used before will not work: wait for the next one.
stepUp.codeRefused: The code is wrong or has already been used.
stepUp.passwordText: The second factor is off, so this action needs the password typed just now.

password.heading: Password
password.hint: Changing the password ends your other sessions and revokes the trusted devices. This session stays signed in.
password.currentWrong: The current password is not correct.
password.tooShort: The new password needs at least {{min}} characters.
password.tooLong: The new password can have at most {{max}} characters.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
password.changed: The password is changed. Your other sessions and the trusted devices were ended.

recovery.heading: Recovery codes
recovery.hint: Each recovery code signs you in once when you cannot use the authenticator app. New codes replace all the old ones at once.
recovery.unavailable: Recovery codes are used with the second factor, which is off.
recovery.shown: These are your new recovery codes. They are shown only now and the old ones no longer work.
recovery.saved: I have saved these codes in a safe place.
recovery.acknowledged: The new recovery codes are saved.

factor.heading: Second factor
factor.on: Sign-in asks for a TOTP code from the authenticator app.
factor.off: The second factor is off: the password alone protects the account.
factor.restartHint: Set TOTP up again if you changed phones or lost the app. The old secret, the recovery codes, the other sessions and the trusted devices stop working.
factor.turnOnHint: Turn the second factor on by setting TOTP up.
factor.offWarning: Without the second factor anyone who knows the password can sign in and read all of your data. Recovery codes and trusted devices are removed.
factor.offRisk: I understand that the password alone will protect the account.
factor.turnedOff: The second factor is off. Your other sessions and the trusted devices were ended.
